title: fix(service-analytics): a compareTo dataset answer fills the time buckets empty in both windows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCk5RnKsekSKbGXkwHbRvqM)_

Fixes #27111

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：带 `compareTo`（同比/环比）的数据集查询，现在也会补上“两个时间段都没有数据”的时间桶：计数和求和读 `0`（本期列和 `__compare` 对照列都是），平均/最小/最大不写这个键。生产代码只删了一处：`timeBucketFillPlan` 里对 `compareTo` 的提前返回，补零沿用 #26893 的同一套规则。
- **为什么改**：#26893 只给普通序列补了零，`compareTo` 被刻意跳过。同比趋势图里，两年都空的月份仍然缺失，图表把它两边的月份画成相邻。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只在带 `compareTo` 的查询上生效；任一窗口有数据的桶、`limit`/`offset`、按度量或 `__compare` 列排序、2,000 行上限等守卫都不变，普通序列逐字节不变。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts`（`timeBucketFillPlan` 的一行与其文档注释）；`packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-time-bucket-zero-fill.test.ts`（新的两个 `[#27111]` describe 块）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/dataset-time-bucket-zero-fill.test.ts`，预期 27/27 通过；把那一处提前返回加回去，同一文件 5 条失败（两边都空的月份消失），2 条对照仍绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`DatasetExecutor.timeBucketFillPlan` returned no plan when `selection.compareTo` was set, the deliberate skip #26893 (PR #27109) left for this card. The skip is lifted; nothing else in the production path changes.

- **One fill rule.** A `compareTo` answer gets the same `TimeBucketFillPlan` and the same `fillEmptyTimeBuckets` walk a plain series gets. No second walker, no new helper.
- **The primary window decides the buckets.** The plan reads the axis's own `timeDimensions[].dateRange`, never the shifted one. It runs after the comparison merge, where `alignedCompareBucketKey` has already restated the comparison rows in primary bucket keys (when the axis is the anchor), so a bucket either window holds is already a row and keeps the merge's values. What the fill adds is only a bucket empty in both windows.
- **The `__compare` columns.** Measured, not changed: `fillColumns` already lists `MEASURE__compare` beside each base measure (`dataset-executor.ts` L1364), and `fillEmptyGroups` runs after the bucket fill. So an added row reads `0` for `count`/`sum` in both the measure and its `__compare`, and `avg`/`min`/`max` are absent keys on both sides (pinned in the tests and seen live below). Derived measures are evaluated after the fill, as before.
- **Guards unchanged for `compareTo`.** `limit`/`offset`, an `order` on a non-dimension key (a measure, a `__compare` column, a derived measure), more than one bucketed axis, and `MAX_ZERO_FILLED_GRID_ROWS`.
- **An axis with no `dateRange` of its own** (the comparison anchored on another, window-only date dimension) gets its interior gaps filled and no edges, the same one-bound rule a plain series follows. That is the only "unbounded" `compareTo` shape that exists: `compareTo` refuses an anchor without a two-bound `dateRange` (`resolveCompareDimension`, `explicitDateRangeWindow`).
- The `timeBucketFillPlan` docblock now states the `compareTo` reading instead of "a separate question".

## Tests

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-time-bucket-zero-fill.test.ts` (the real `AnalyticsServicePlugin` over a real ObjectQL engine and a real SQLite driver, as in #26893):

- The #26893 `compareTo keeps its shape` control pinned the skip, so it is replaced by the card's own case: May–August 2026 vs the previous year (2025-05..08 empty) answers `2026-05, 06, 07, 08`, with `total_amount` `[0, 70, 80, 0]`, every `__compare` `0`, `opp_count`/`opp_count__compare` `toBe(0)` on May and August, and `avg_amount` / `avg_amount__compare` absent keys.
- A new fixture (stage `cmp_probe`), one month in each state: both windows, primary only, compare only, neither. Cases:
  - the full sequence `2026-03|1|1, 04|1|0, 05|0|1, 06|0|0, 07|1|0, 08|0|0` (count, count `__compare`) plus the sums: the three one-window months and the both-window month keep the merge's values, June and August are added;
  - the primary columns of the `compareTo` answer equal the plain series' answer for the same window (one fill rule);
  - `previousPeriod` (June–August vs March–May, ordinal alignment): `06|0|1, 07|1|1, 08|0|0`;
  - an axis with no `dateRange` (anchor `closed_at`, window-only): every month between the first and last bucket the grid holds (`2025-03` … `2026-07`), none before or after;
  - controls: `limit` with `compareTo`, and an `order` on `opp_count__compare`, are not filled (4 rows, the base answer).
- Fixture fallout, one file: `dataset-compare-bucket-alignment.test.ts` `day` uses a window (1–4 March) wider than its rows (2–3 March), so 1 and 4 March now come back at `0 / 0`. The expected rows are updated with exact values; the alignment it pins (`03-02` ↔ 5, `03-03` ↔ 6) is unchanged.

<details><summary>Ablation: restoring the compareTo early return</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `dataset-executor.ts`, anchor `if (selection.limit != null || selection.offset != null) return undefined;` → `if (selection.compareTo || selection.limit != null || selection.offset != null) return undefined;` (anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `201a3ec3` → `0fe9ae21`). The suite imports the executor from `src/`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

```
× May–August vs the previous year: May and August come back, with 0 in the measure and in its __compare
× a bucket either window holds keeps the merge's values; June and August are added at 0 / 0
× the primary columns are the plain series' answer: one fill rule
× previousPeriod aligns by ordinal and fills the same way
× an axis with no dateRange of its own (a window-only anchor) fills interior gaps only, no edges
Tests  5 failed | 22 passed (27)
```

The base answer for the fixture case was `2026-03|1|1, 04|1|0, 05|0|1, 07|1|0`: the one-window months are the same rows with the same values. Restore: blob after restore `201a3ec3` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Live red/green through the REST door (app-crm, opportunity_metrics)</summary>

`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p PORT` after a full `pnpm build`, signed in as the dev admin, `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` with `datasetName: opportunity_metrics`, `runtimeFilter: { stage: 'closed_won' }`, `timeDimensions: [{ dimension: 'close_date', dateRange: ['2026-06-01', '2026-10-31'] }]`, measures `opp_count`, `total_amount`, `avg_amount`. The seed's closed-won deals sit in 2026-07, 2026-10, 2025-09 and 2025-10. Red = the base blob of `dataset-executor.ts` (`55592517`) written over the file and `@objectstack/service-analytics` rebuilt (dist marker `selection.compareTo || selection.limit`: 1 hit each in `index.js` / `index.cjs`); green = HEAD rebuilt (0 hits). Restore proven by the blob hash equal to HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` empty. Columns: count / count `__compare`, sum / sum `__compare`, avg.

```
A  compareTo previousYear
RED    200  rows 3
  2026-07 opp 2 / 0 amt 170000 / 0      avg=85000  avgc-absent
  2026-09 opp 0 / 1 amt 0 / 210000      avg-absent avgc=210000
  2026-10 opp 3 / 1 amt 235000 / 75000  avg=78333.33 avgc=75000
GREEN  200  rows 5
  2026-06 opp 0 / 0 amt 0 / 0           avg-absent avgc-absent
  2026-07 opp 2 / 0 amt 170000 / 0      avg=85000  avgc-absent
  2026-08 opp 0 / 0 amt 0 / 0           avg-absent avgc-absent
  2026-09 opp 0 / 1 amt 0 / 210000      avg-absent avgc=210000
  2026-10 opp 3 / 1 amt 235000 / 75000  avg=78333.33 avgc=75000

B  same + limit 10 (control): RED and GREEN both 3 rows, identical to RED A
C  plain series, same window (control): RED and GREEN both 5 rows, identical
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-②: no**, measured: no input is refused or newly accepted, no export or type changes (the diff touches one private method's guard and comments); a `compareTo` answer gains rows it lacked. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- The pending `.changeset/26893-time-series-empty-buckets.md` (unreleased, from PR #27109) still lists `compareTo` under **Not filled**. It is left at its base bytes: the required `Check Changeset` gate refuses any change to a changeset this PR did not add (#17712). Instead, this PR's own changeset ends with a sentence that supersedes that `compareTo` mention for the same release (seat claim amendment 2, `6467147455`).
- Dogfood: no dogfood file sends a `compareTo` (`git grep -l compareTo -- packages/qa` is empty), and this diff changes an answer only when `compareTo` is set, so the full battery is not run (no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm).
